description: Bring to you 3M sticky circular adhesive replacement pads with heat resistant VHB double sided strong self-sticking. Designed exclusively for magnetic cell phone stands, finger ring holders, socket grip mounts & magnetic car mounts. This works with car dashcams as well. They are a perfect replacement for the tapes that came with your car mount which lasted a few months but then started to fail. These adhesive stickers are extremely powerful, provide strong and durable support. Instead of purchasing a new car mobile holder, just replace the adhesive sticker from the bottom of the holder, making it as good as new and ready for reuse. To use these pads, please clean the dashboard surface with the alcohol pad provided & let it dry. Then, peel off the white side of the adhesive and stick it to the car mount base. After applying some pressure on the adhesive, peel off the red film side of the adhesive and stick the car mount to your dashboard/ windshield surface area. Apply pressure for 1 minute and wait for 24 hours to use after installation. You must always position the mount where there's a flat, smooth & plain surface on the car dashboard. Avoid textured surfaces or panels.
